本项目与 DeepSeek 官方无隶属、合作或背书关系；DeepSeek Harness 名称与品牌素材归其权利人所有。
覆盖长篇、短篇、选题、扫榜、拆文、导入、审稿、去 AI 味与封面流程。13 个 Oh Story Skills 与 7 个专业 Roles 按固定上游版本随插件交付。
内置 Drama Skills 0.6.0 的 creator-first 工作流。每集按请求维护最多五份可读 Markdown：剧本.md、视觉设定.md、分镜.md、图片提示词.md、视频提示词.md；不预建空文档，也不倒补用户未点名的阶段。审查与生产交付继续使用 DSH 原生工具、权限和确认界面。
Drama Skills 0.6.0 是破坏性升级：v0.5 结构化项目应继续锁定 v0.5 并只读保留；迁移时新建项目根，逐集人工确认当前工作所需文档，不要在同一目录混用旧 JSON/JSONL 与新文档。
- 原生三栏布局：项目文件树、编辑器与官方 Chat 同屏，Trajectory、工具执行、Todo、审批和 Composer 保持 DSH 原生交互。
- 实时文件跟随：Agent 调用官方文件工具时，目标文件自动定位，编辑器同步呈现生成中的内容。
- Chat 文件导航：点击官方 Chat 中的作品文件名，文件树会定位并在编辑器打开对应文件。
- 创作文档预览：Markdown 支持标题、表格、任务列表、引用和代码块；JSONL 以带行号、类型和状态的结构化记录呈现。
- 安全编辑：支持源码编辑与快捷保存；人工未保存内容不会被并发 Agent 修改覆盖。
- 稳定长对话：消息区独立滚动，官方 Composer 固定在 Chat 栏底部。
需要 Node.js 24+。
1.

items.title: When Words Are Safe But Actions Kill: Probing Physical Jailbreak Beyond Textual Jailbreak in Hidden-State Risk Space
items.one_liner: PRISM uses hidden-state probing to detect physical safety risks in embodied AI agents without relying on error-prone text moderation.
items.summary: Large language models acting as planners for embodied agents can receive linguistically benign instructions that become unsafe when grounded in the physical world. Researchers studied whether this physical jailbreak (PJ) differs from textual jailbreak (TJ) and showed that they form separable signals across multiple LLM families. To detect physical risks, they introduced PRISM, a single-layer L2-regularized logistic probe over full hidden states, which achieves 86.2% to 87.7% accuracy on SafeAgentBench and outperforms standard LLM judges while drastically reducing false-positive rates.
items.bottom_line: Hidden-state probing successfully separates physical jailbreaks from textual jailbreaks in LLM representations, offering a robust safety filter for embodied AI agents.

claims.text: PRISM achieves 86.2--87.7% accuracy on SafeAgentBench with 11.7--13.7% false-positive rates (FPRs), while same-scale LLM judges over-block safe tasks at 24.7--39.0% FPR.

items.title: Structure for Reading, Prose for Writing: Asymmetric Structural Conditioning in Multi-Agent Document Authoring
items.one_liner: Multi-agent document authoring systems suffer when instructions use nested XML structure rather than prose.
items.summary: Researchers evaluated a deployed multi-agent tender-response system against human-submitted bids and found that divergence from ground truth is primarily an information-availability issue rather than a writing-quality one. The study identified a conditioning asymmetry: while structural markup aids reading tasks, converting instruction material from prose to nested XML dropped answer quality from 74% to 48% in paired comparisons. Furthermore, naming a forbidden construction concentrates rather than removes it, with 96% of surviving defects falling into the two explicitly named forms.
key_facts: Ground-truth sections matched or beaten: 40 of 55
Prose to nested XML quality drop: 74% to 48%
Surviving defects in named forbidden forms: 96%
items.bottom_line: Structural markup helps multi-agent systems read documents, but converting instruction material to structural markup severely degrades answer quality during writing.

claims.text:
市面上绝大多数所谓的「AI 深度调研」，本质是 Wide Research：并行搜一堆来源，按主题分好类，给你一份工整的 checklist。看起来很全，事实也没错，但没用——它只有目录，没有判断。
这个 skill 把 Agent 掰到另一条路上：Deep Research。精读一手源，把它们之间的矛盾挑出来，最后落到一个业内人真的会跟你争论的判断上。
Wide Research 是 LLM 的出厂设置，产出的是「正确的废话」。这个 skill 就是一套护栏，把它从默认模式里拽出来。
一套四阶段工作流，以及比工作流更重要的东西：不让 Agent 跳过 Phase 0 的纪律。
Phase 0　元思考 — 绝不外包
一次搜索都还没发起，先拷问问题本身：为什么问这个？隐藏假设是什么？有没有一个「显而易见但其实不对」的标准答案，而这篇报告的全部价值就是说清它为什么不对？然后写下「好答案」该长什么样：核心论点摆到一屋子业内人面前得能吵起来，而不是集体点头。
Phase 1　一手源精读
找到那 3 到 5 篇真正的原始文献（财报、创始人自己写的博文、电话会议逐字稿、论文原文），完整读完。二手总结每转一手，洞见就蒸发一层。
Phase 2　对比与反例
选 2 到 3 个案例做深度对比，专门去挖失败案例和批评声音。收敛本身是发现，分歧背后的原因是更大的发现。
Phase 3　交叉验证
多源印证的可信，单源的标注存疑，互相矛盾的——这才是最有意思的地方，去分析这个矛盾意味着什么。
Phase 4　把论证写出来
段落优先于表格，每一章只推进一个论点，诚实标注不知道的部分。最后一道自检：如果核心结论放到业内不会引发任何争论，重写。
这个文件最值钱的部分是「翻车目录」：把 Agent 最容易走的捷径一条条写下来，每条都配一个检测信号，让你（或 Agent）当场判断是不是正在犯。
1 · 跳过 Phase 0 直接搜 没有假设引导，subagent 返回的是信息碎片，不是论证素材。
检测信号：subagent 的 prompt 里没有「假设」或「待验证的论点」。
2 · 拿 subagent 的返回结构当报告骨架 你会得到一个伪装成分析的主题目录。
检测信号：章节标题拿去当搜索关键词刚好合适（「定价对比」「适合谁」）——那是文件柜，不是论证。
3 · 用表格和 bullet 替代思考 一个洞见如果能塞进表格，它大概率不是洞见。
检测信号：删掉所有表格和 bullet 后，剩下的段落撑不起一篇文章。
4 · 结论太安全 「A 适合新手，B 适合老手」这种话不用调研就能说。
检测信号：核心结论发到专业群里，没人会出来反驳或讨论。
5 · 把「全面」当「深度」 10 个维度各 3 句，输给 3 个维度各 3 段。
检测信号：报告过万字，但核心论点三句话就能说完。
6 · 子 agent 递归 fan-out 一次真实事故就是这条规则的由来：主 agent 派 3 个 → 变 13 个 → 变 50+ → 最终 149 个 agent，一笔意外的 API 账单。
检测信号：你在给子 agent 的 prompt 里写了「你可以用 Agent 工具进一步搜索」。停，马上要炸。
1.

items.title: WordlistLoader Delivers Amatera via ClickFix, SynkLoader Phishes Windows Passwords
items.one_liner: New malware loaders are using 'ClickFix' social engineering and legitimate cloud infrastructure to deliver stealers and ransomware.
items.summary: Researchers have identified two new malware loaders, WordlistLoader and SynkLoader, being used in sophisticated phishing campaigns. WordlistLoader utilizes the 'ClickFix' technique to trick users into executing malicious PowerShell commands via the Windows Run dialog, leading to the delivery of Amatera Stealer. SynkLoader, a Python-based loader, uses Azure-hosted installers and a custom runtime to steal credentials and facilitate ransomware access. These campaigns leverage legitimate CDNs like jsDelivr and techniques like EtherHiding to bypass security controls.
items.bottom_line: Attackers are increasingly using social engineering to trick users into running commands that bypass browser protections and deliver stealthy loaders.

claims.text: WordlistLoader uses the ClickFix technique to deliver Amatera Stealer.
claims.support_span: WordlistLoader is being used to deliver Amatera Stealer (aka ACR Stealer or AcridRain Stealer) via ClearFake campaigns, which employ the ClickFix (aka FakeCaptcha) technique

claims.text: SynkLoader uses a custom Python environment to steal Windows passwords.
claims.support_span: WordlistLoader Delivers Amatera via ClickFix, SynkLoader Phishes Windows Passwords

items.title: Beyond End-to-End Success: Diagnosing Failures in Long-Horizon Security LLM Agents
items.one_liner: Diagnose security LLM agent failures using checkpoint instrumentation rather than relying solely on aggregate end-to-end task success rates.
items.summary: Long-horizon security LLM agents depend on information and access discovered across multiple interactions, making final end-to-end success metrics difficult to interpret when failures occur early. The authors introduce a diagnostic methodology that adds checkpoints to security tasks, separates failures occurring before and after capability exposure, and applies controlled interventions to test upstream bottlenecks. Evaluating four task families showed that Gemini 2.5 Flash frequently failed before observing states it needed to reuse, and targeted guidance successfully increased state observation from 65.5% to 95.4% in a 92-seed study. However, repeating the study with Gemini 3.7 Flash produced opposite behavioral shifts where state observation no longer predicted task completion. These results highlight that dominant failure points shift across model generations, necessitating granular diagnostic evaluations over aggregate success rates.
key_facts: Evaluated models: Gemini 2.5 Flash, Gemini 3.7 Flash
items.bottom_line: Model bottlenecks shift across generations, proving that granular checkpoint-based diagnostics are essential for understanding why long-horizon security agents fail.

claims.text: In a pre-specified 92-seed study, targeted protocol-disambiguation guidance increases state observation from 65.5% under a matched non-guidance control message to 95.4%.
claims.support_span: In a pre-specified 92-seed study, targeted protocol-disambiguation guidance increases state observation from 65.5% under a matched non-guidance control message to 95.4%.

claims.text: Repeating the same design with Gemini 3.7 Flash produces the opposite effect, while state observation no longer reliably predicts task completion.
claims.support_span: Repeating the same design with Gemini 3.7 Flash produces the opposite effect, while state observation no longer reliably predicts task completion.

items.title: Horizon Industrial Parks IPO listing: Shares debut flat in a range-bound market
items.one_liner: Horizon Industrial Parks' flat debut reflects cautious market sentiment despite its position as a major logistics developer.
items.summary: Shares of Horizon Industrial Parks debuted flat on the BSE and NSE on Monday in a range-bound market, opening near the issue price of 60 rupees. The IPO had achieved an overall subscription of 1.52 times during its bidding window last week. The company intends to direct net proceeds from the 2,600 crore rupee fresh issue towards debt repayment and corporate purposes. Horizon operates a large logistics infrastructure network across major Indian industrial hubs and reported a profit of 0.14 crore rupees for the 2026 fiscal year.
items.bottom_line: Horizon Industrial Parks shares listed flat on domestic bourses after raising funds to pay down debt.

items.title: Evaluating Skills, Not Just Agents: Agentic Continuous Evaluation of Skills
items.one_liner: ACES measures live enterprise agent skill efficacy through paired trials, showing that static code scans miss critical runtime performance gains.
items.summary: Enterprise agent programs are moving into production, but current static gates only scan skill artifacts for structure, style, and security without verifying whether capability packages actually improve live agent task completion. The authors present ACES (Agentic Continuous Evaluation of Skills), a repository-native framework that runs paired live trials with and without a target skill to compute Skill Lift: the target skill's added value under a fixed task, harness, workspace, and scorer. Across 947 scored paired cases from 58 production skills, mean composite Skill Lift is 0.2134, with composite lift positive in 72.8 percent of cases. The results show that structural document scans and runtime execution evaluations measure complementary facets, with process gains appearing in skill execution and efficiency.
key_facts: Evaluated skills: 145 real skills from enterprise repositories
Scored paired cases: 947 cases across 58 production skills
items.bottom_line: Static security and style scans do not measure whether an enterprise agent skill actually improves live task execution.

claims.text: Current gates often scan these artifacts for structure, style, and security, but they do not answer the deployment question: does the capability package help a live agent complete enterprise tasks under the same model, sandbox, and grading policy?
claims.support_span: Current gates often scan these artifacts for structure, style, and security, but they do not answer the deployment question: does the capability package help a live agent complete enterprise tasks under the same model, sandbox, and grading policy?

claims.text: Across 947 scored paired cases from 58 of 64 production skills and four primary harnesses, mean composite Skill Lift is 0.2134 (95% paired-case CI [0.1967, 0.2301]); mean outcome-only lift, the average of accuracy and goal accuracy, is 0.1799.

items.title: ARQ: Agentic CodeQL Query Refinement for C/C++ Vulnerability Detection
items.one_liner: ARQ uses execution-grounded LLM feedback to automatically refine CodeQL queries, discovering new bugs and eliminating false results.
items.summary: Static analysis tools like CodeQL suffer from false positives and false negatives in C/C++ vulnerability detection. Researchers developed ARQ, an agentic framework that automatically refines CodeQL queries using execution-grounded evidence from synthesized programs via an LLM-based loop. Tested across three commercial LLMs on Juliet v1.3 and FormAI v2 datasets, ARQ-refined queries detected up to 119.8% more true positives while maintaining at least 98.0% precision, fixed three unresolved GitHub issues open for up to 27 months, and uncovered two new bugs in libpng and zlib.
key_facts: Open duration of fixed issues: up to 27 months
Real-world libraries with new bugs: libpng and zlib
items.bottom_line: Agentic query refinement using synthesized program execution significantly boosts CodeQL true positive detection while uncovering real-world vulnerabilities in major libraries.

claims.text: ARQ-refined queries detect substantially more true positives, by up to 119.8%, with a Precision of at least 98.0% throughout.
claims.support_span: ARQ-refined queries detect substantially more true positives, by up to 119.8%, with a Precision of at least 98.0% throughout.
